title: Odd Semester 2026 Examination Schedule Released
content: The tentative schedule for 3rd semester university examinations is now available on the portal. Practical exams will commence from November 15.

title: Campus Placement Drive: TCS & Infosys Registration
content: Eligible final and pre-final year students must submit their updated resume and CGPA proof to the T&P cell before October 20.

title: National Level Web Hackathon Registration Open
content: Registrations for the Web Hackathon 2026 are now open. Visit the events section to sign up your team of 3-4 members.

title: Central Library Extended Reading Room Hours
content: The central library reading hall will remain open until 11:00 PM on weekdays to assist students preparing for mid-term tests.
